description: This is a general arrangement drawing showing the layout of systems on a vessel. The drawing includes three main sections: 'PLAN VIEW - INTERIOR', 'PLAN VIEW - SYSTEMS', and a detailed 'PLAN VIEW - ENGINE ROOM'. The interior plan shows the general layout of compartments and spaces, such as the lazarette, cabins, saloon, and heads. The systems plan overlays various mechanical and electrical components onto this layout, indicating their locations. The engine room plan provides a larger-scale view of the equipment within the engine room space, including generators, pumps, and other machinery. A comprehensive table at the bottom of the drawing lists all the items shown, categorized by system (e.g., Main Hardware, Steering, Appliances, Main Propulsion, Drivetrain, Exhaust, Bow Thruster, Stern Thruster, Fresh Water, Raw Water & Cooling, Bilge & Fire, Grey Water, Black Water, Fuel, Fire Suppression, Power Hydraulics, Pneumatics, Refrigeration, Aircon, Ventilation, Power Generation, Power Conversion, Energy Storage), providing details such as Ref, Item, OEM, Model, High Voltage (HV), Low Voltage (LV), and QTY. Notes are also included, referencing other drawings for details on electrical components layout and deck hardware.
